[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- 06_stress_max_tasks.volt:6[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 5 controls boot debug output. Usually safe for general use.

 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin p2: Output = 4
 [dim]6 |[/dim]     pin p3: Output = 5
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^[/yellow]


[yellow bold]-- CONCURRENCY -- 06_stress_max_tasks.volt:34[/yellow bold]

Variable `isr1_count` is shared between isr1 (critical) and stress_report. Each read and write is atomic in the generated C.

 [dim]33 |[/dim] var t10_count: int = 0
 [dim]34 |[/dim] var isr1_count: int = 0
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: An update spread over several statements can still interleave; keep it in one statement or use a channel.[/cyan]

 [dim]35 |[/dim] var isr2_count: int = 0
